title: Compute brief - 6 October 2026
description: Three Wire ids: Google funds 890 MW of new nuclear uprates and signs 2,700 MW more supply with Constellation in PJM; Applied Digital energizes 75 MW more at Polaris Forge 1 (250 MW live); JERA, Dell and RHAELM sign an MoU for a 400 MW behind-the-meter AI campus at Chiba, Japan. Silicon Tape confirm day (69/0/0). AWS Capacity Blocks card takes effect 7 Oct.
og_kicker: Google buys new nuclear in PJM; Japan's Chiba 400 MW
lede: The theme on Tuesday is power turning into compute. Google and Constellation signed a 20-year PPA that pays for uprates at 11 nuclear units, adding 890 MW of new capacity to PJM, plus a 15-year supply deal for 2,700 MW more (about 3,590 MW in total). Applied Digital reached Ready for Service on 75 MW more at Polaris Forge 1 in North Dakota, so 250 MW of the 400 MW campus is now live. In Japan, JERA, Dell and RHAELM signed an MoU for a 400 MW behind-the-meter AI campus at the Chiba Thermal Power Station, with more than US$15 billion of planned capital and Apollo as intended financing partner. The public rental tape is a full confirm session: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW across Lambda, CoreWeave, Crusoe, DigitalOcean, GCP TPU and AWS Capacity Blocks. AWS's new Capacity Blocks card takes effect Wednesday 7 Oct (P5 $5.970, P6-B300 $16.146); today's live table still prints P5 Virginia $5.191 and P6-B300 Virginia $14.04. Applied Digital also announced access to up to 1 GW of potential power in Finland, with no counterparty or tenant named. Brookwood's council vote is still pending. PUCT 58481 takes effect 8 Oct; ERCOT RFI due 12 Oct; TCEQ update due 19 Oct; Fermi x TensorWave Matador due 31 Oct.
